rulesTestNames: admits the owner and the coordinator duty to the settings view, by id only
owner: Programme read model projector: programWhatsapp settingViewTriggers
read: get by programme id for the programme owner and the coordinator duty (programAccessViews), as requireSettingsAccess admits them, while not deleted; never listed
write: server only; written from organizerPrograms, programAssistantSettings and programStaffGrants
migrationNotes: Replaces getProgramAssistantSettings for the Host app (#2306): the settings exactly as the callable returned them (defaults with usesDefaults and revision 0 when none are saved) and the escalation staff with each grant's expiry instead of the callable's clock filter. Saving stays updateProgramAssistantSettings, fenced by the revision. The program-setting-views copy-forward migration creates views for programmes that predate the triggers.
Staff display names are personal data; archive anonymization scrubs them on the grant, and the grant trigger rewrites the view.
